items.statement: Within the submitted periodic model and validated numerical settings, the electronic observables support the authors' qualitative bonding and noncentrosymmetric-electron-distribution interpretation.
items.expected: The conclusion explicitly scopes support to the calculated model, cites DOS and ELF evidence, and states any method sensitivity or incomplete-observable limitation.

items.statement: Qualitative agreement does not establish a unique bonding decomposition or eliminate uncertainty from unspecified ordinary numerical settings.
items.expected: The report distinguishes computed evidence from causal overinterpretation and records omitted k-point, smearing, PAW or DOS/ELF-tag details when applicable.
